minimalsanitized.rationale: ROOT_CAUSE - External call to user-controlled market address without reentrancy guard. Attacker's fake market reenters deposit() during callback, manipulating userBalances before state updates.

PREREQ - Market registration accepts any address without validation. This enables the attacker to register a malicious fake market, which is necessary to exploit the reentrancy in CA1. The direct vulnerability is the CEI violation (CA1), this is the enabling condition.
Function body showing CEI violation context. The vulnerability is modeled in CA1 (external call) and CA2 (unvalidated registration) - this is supporting context.
Standard deposit function (though reentered during attack).
Standard withdraw function used to extract inflated balance.
